decisions.reason: As a multi-model illustrated series with high visible investment and centrality to the firm's announced expansion, accumulated commitments make abandonment unlikely.
Though a single LP, it builds directly on the firm's reissue expertise and has had its own page, so sunk costs and public visibility argue for persistence.
The multi-disc box set represents substantial production investment and collector-oriented visibility, reinforcing commitment despite the passage of time.
This compilation CD has low visibility and investment similar to the already-dropped schlager CD, so without strong sunk-cost or public-commitment pressures it can be dropped to reallocate resources.
